lines.trans: Did you find the three folding chairs behind the boiler cellar, Werner?
Found the chairs, and behind an old brick wall I found this box.
A small wooden box? I have never seen that little chest in fifteen years!
Wipe the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

lines.trans: Werner, look at the key board behind us: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!
Our guesthouse has only ever had eight rooms! Where on earth is Room nine?!

On the front latch there is a tiny keyhole, and taped underneath is an old brass key!
A ninth brass key?! Do we open it tonight or wait until morning?!
